r.s: Class for parsing and handling URL.
r.d: Provides parsing of URLs into their constituent parts (scheme, host, path etc.), URL generation, and resolving of relative URLs.
r.n: * Fixed #20161: URLs with "0" as host fail to normalize with empty path * A flaw in NetURL2::removeDotSegments() introduced in 2.0.1 has been fixed * New: NetURL2::removeDotSegments() emits a warning on loop limit reach * Url-segment maximum count raised from 100 to 256 (loop limit)
